city.title: 纸城河港

Four substantial stone bridges at z=62,124,190,264. Primary road loop, diagonal boulevard, paved squares, quay promenade, freight railway curve, crosswalks, street lamps, benches, parking and pedestrians. Vary district density/architecture, keep wide combat routes. Uneven noncircular coastline and small wooded fringe; city dominates, no empty giant center.

islands.title: 远海群岛
islands.design: An ocean archipelago with 65 percent connected teal sea and organic irregular island silhouettes, not perfect circles. Four main home islands centered on corner base areas(84,84),(236,84),(236,236),(84,236), each about40m radius with coves, rocky tips, sandy bays, green inland hills and palm groves. One central contested crescent island around(160,160), with old stone fort ruins at(155,156), ring beach and small lagoon. Eight smaller expansion islets between and outside home islands, separated by broad connected navigable channels. Distinct fish village at(84,66), tall striped lighthouse on a rocky point near(237,102), sheltered marina near(219,242), wreck/rock formation near(100,246). Wooden piers, boat sheds, buoys, tidal sandbanks, palms, coastal boulders, island tracks and clear landing beaches on each main island. Open flat base construction areas and symmetrical ore values on all four home islands, but organic coastline and scenery variation. Navy must be able to sail between all islands, no disconnected water pockets.
